content: 16:1-4 Nomon qur Yerusalem wurit imurimau end Pol qamarei
See an nomon qur qiumuni Qenu munon yurau Yudia igour eng werisub at igoumon end ye aninob qemeribam eng. Qenu yurau Galesia igour eng wuriimbigine ebet igour gas ende an gor ende abar.

Inorou gugum nomon qur baub igoumon eng an gari-gari nomon qur eng boopur wesopur bigari igoriner. Ende obounon eng ye yarab qemerine bo nomon qurt asi me ubunanei, eng gari bigunon eng ba bo qiumuni biguboumon.
Qen geret ye yarine yegab aninou der munon qei wurimaribigari nomon qur banam werisub qamb bigumon eng ba Yerusalem qite irubour. Irubari ye namanimun gumat wurisab wuriimurimine irubour.
A yonou qenunget nob irib qamb eng yonou nob iribam.
16:5-12 Pol Korin ibegeib qamb misir igorei
Ye anit yarib eng gigit Masedonia end irab sarau bais ebet-ebet wogub qanamt anit yaribam.
Ye yarab aninob igorun eng ya darau qen end qen gurum aninob igoribam. Igoi wogub ai bo sigenima gab tumbigi isibine an qei ye nob isuboumon.
An mom imbigoumon eng, an ar qataben igamari yar animbigeau eng ye ietroum. Munon Aib wonou qenunga gab eng ye yarab mom gurum aninob igoribam.
Ego ye Epesus end igo Igomurur qau derer wonou qen eng ubura anit yarib qamb misir igoum.
Qenu ye sarau eng eb qamb tap tog aib imosau gas ende ebeterei igo. End ye sarau ebine munon irou Yisas imbigar qamb ebeibam ego munon qarau irou igour.
Timoti anit iroa gab an banamsi musub nob igoarar, wo ye Munon Aib sarau baab qib igoum gas ende ebet qib igo.

Wo git wau moi end an qei der ber qob nob qamb qiyo a qei der siningot ende me abar. Qi musub banamsi nob igoi wogub wonou yarau qen eng gab musub imurimari yet yariner. Ye banamori qei oromar wo e qoat igoruboun.
Ne ininou munon banam Apolos wot qemeribam eng: wo wonou munon banam qei wurinob irab animbogounor qamb qenen sesimot igoum. Ego wo sig iet wogub igo, qen geret qen uber ger gab eng anit iriba.
16:13-24 Pol wonou qob sasam
An Munon Aibt oabig eng mom qeretutnob tenori ete mom qoyamet igoarar. Ne gor munon qarau wurit me uburab isar.
An mi gugum ebet gab eng Qenut igub ne gor munon wuriqenungar abar.
Io, an Stepanas wonou yurau eng nob ebetemir eng an imbig igoumon eng. Wuri Grik yurau end wuri gigit Yisas yurau burab wogub wurinou misirt Qenu munon yurau wurimusub igour eng.
Ye qenungoum eng Stepanas wonou yurau nob igamari an munon eng ii igoarar qamb misir igoum. Ebet ne munon qei der munon qei wurimusub igamari ibag an gor der qomon eng toat ebet nonogursi igoarar.
Stepanas ne Portunatus ne Akaikus wuri ye yogoub qamb yarari ye borusi mismisiramei. An e me yurunanei end wuri uput qamb yarari menman ibag uberetamei.
Wuri yarab ye oau pomaimsiamirei. Qoan wuri yarab an oau anpomaimsiamir gas ende ye gor ende yesiamirei. End ne an munon eng ebetemir eng wurit igar.
Sios munon Esia igour eng anit uber qamb igour. Akwila Prisila nob wurinou munon yurau eng qenen wurinou ombur munai mor end qiumuni igo. Munon Aib gab-gab anit uber qamb igour.
In Qenu wonou munon yurau e igoun eng gugum anit uber qamb igoun. End aninou gari-gari qibanamsi igoarar.
Ye Pol, yonou ubent munon banamsi uber igoarar qob eng gumotoroum.
Munon ger Munon Aib me wot oabiginer eng mom uburiba. Ininou Munon Barai, init yar.
Munon Aib Yisas wonou oau mein eng anit isub yab di iua igoriner.
Munon inubersiau tari Yisas gab-gab ye an gugum anqenungar quraum eng.
